subject: Re: Coordination on inference demo — temporary deprioritization
messages:

Subject: Re: Scheduling inference demo — next steps

Hi Priya / Marco —

Thanks for the quick reply on availability. Per our last call we prepared a short runbook and a draft SOW to make the pilot kickoff smoother (attached). If it helps, we can do a compact 30-minute technical walkthrough next week with product + infra to show the latency/cost tradeoffs on a sample dataset.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 6/30 11:00–11:30
- Wed 7/1 09:00–09:30
- Thu 7/2 14:00–14:30

If none of those work, happy to record a 15-minute async demo and send the recording. Let me know which option you prefer.

Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf (stub), Ops-Roadmap.xlsx (stub)

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Shen <priya.shen@latticeops.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@latticeops.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 10:36:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling inference demo — next steps

Hi Irene —

Appreciate the materials and the flexibility. Quick update from our side: we just got sign-off on a major product launch that shifts engineering priorities for the next 8–10 weeks. Leadership reallocated two ML engineers from experimental projects into the launch squad, so we need to deprioritize new inference pilots for now.

Would you mind pausing the scheduling? We still want to stay engaged — can we revisit in mid-September? If you have a short recorded walkthrough we can circulate internally, that would be helpful to keep momentum.

Thanks for understanding,
Priya Shen
Head of Platform Product
LatticeOps

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Priya Shen <priya.shen@latticeops.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@latticeops.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling inference demo — next steps

Thanks for the update, Priya — totally understand the launch prioritization, congrats on the milestone.

Two quick options from our side to keep the deal warm without taking up your engineers:
1) We can record a compact 12–15 minute async demo (screen + voice) that focuses on onboarding, expected latency, and the minimal infra footprint. I can include a short appendix on quantization profiles and cost estimates specific to the sample you shared.
2) If you prefer live interaction, we can do a one-hour workshop in September after your launch — I can tentatively block a couple of dates and confirm once you give the green light.

If option 1 works, we’ll produce the recording and a one-page TL;DR for internal circulation. Please confirm if we have permission to circulate it to Platform/Product stakeholders and whether Marco is the right engineering recipient.

—Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: short-demo-script.txt)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Cc: Priya Shen <priya.shen@latticeops.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@latticeops.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination on inference demo — temporary deprioritization

Got it — thanks Karthik, Priya.

Action items for Redwood:
- Karthik to record the 15-min async demo + 1-page TL;DR.
- Rishi/Monica to update the HubSpot deal (DEAL-2026-411) to "nurture/waitlist" and add note: "Customer paused due to product launch; recheck mid-Sept."
- Irene to schedule a reminder and a light-touch outreach cadence (monthly) so we don't lose momentum.

Priya — we’ll send the recording and the one-pager to you and Marco by next Wednesday 7/7. If you want us to tailor the appendix further (e.g., on on-prem constraints or SOC2 scope), flag it and we’ll include.

Thanks again — we’ll stay in touch and circle back in September.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
(https://app.hubspot.com/deals/411/details)
